name: rfc-agent
description: Turns a PRD into a grounded tech RFC in six stages (Scope, Investigate, Draft, Review, Revise, Summarize); every statement about existing code cites a file and line, and deterministic gates check each stage's output. Also ships the agent-agnostic harness and its `testing` workflow (QA test cases from an RFC). Commands: /rfc-agent:setup (first-time setup), /rfc-agent:rfc (the whole pipeline), /rfc-agent:scope, /rfc-agent:investigate, /rfc-agent:draft, /rfc-agent:review, /rfc-agent:revise, /rfc-agent:summarize (one stage each), /rfc-agent:feedback (rate a run), /rfc-agent:doctor (diagnose the install).
